question: Shri Bhupender Yadav, the Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, virtually inaugurated a smog tower in _______ in September 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Environment, Forest, and Climate Change Minister Bhupender Yadav dedicated the first functional Smog Tower in India at Anand Vihar, New Delhi on 7 September 2021.
 
• The smog tower is a structure designed as a large-scale air purifier to reduce pollution particles in surrounding areas.
 
• Built by Tata Company, the tower has a capacity of 1,000 cubic metres per second.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• ​The smog tower at Anand Vihar, with a height of over 20 metres, is of downdraft type - polluted air comes in from the top of the tower and clean air comes out of the bottom - and is intended for the localised reduction in particulate matter.
 
• The filtration system used in the tower has been designed by the University of Minnesota with an expected efficiency of 90 per cent.
 
• Forty fan units have been installed to provide a design airflow rate of 1,000 m3/sec
